assets.rightsBasis: Official site-wide header logo served from the college's own domain (miet.edu). No open licence - used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-26: image/png, 58,674 bytes, 540x100 px (fetched through WebFetch; plain curl to miet.edu returns HTTP 406 to non-browser clients, so re-check HTTP 200 from the upload host). Rendered on white and visually confirmed: blue 'MIET INSTITUTIONS Since 1984' monogram on the left and a blue 'MIET ENGINEERING COLLEGE (Autonomous)' wordmark with the straplines 'Anna University Recognized Research Institute' and 'Accredited by NAAC with A+ Grade' - legible on a white tile, no white-on-transparent elements. CAVEAT: wide header lockup (5.4:1) that combines the group monogram and the college wordmark; small raster, no SVG or larger brand asset found. If a square tile is required, crop the left MIET monogram (approx. x 0-95) rather than using a favicon.
